authority_snapshot.promotion_rule: No R07 recovery evidence promotes Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog ownership or Lineage authority. Version number and catalog liveness are non-authoritative for promotion.

pagekit-v26.meaning: Stable Class Player baseline / rollback donor only; not a global Human Accepted PageKit product.

pagekit-v37.meaning: Descendant capability donor; laser transform tracking is best-known. Whole UX remains unaccepted.

capabilities.decision: V26 remains the registered stable Class Player rollback donor.
All three have generic Pointer Events evidence; this is not Wacom pressure/button evidence.
No inspected implementation reads pressure/buttons. V37 UI text mentioning Wacom is descriptive, not implementation proof.
Names differ by surface; preserve semantics rather than normalize by version label.
Three-point curve behavior is durable in all inspected surfaces, but implementations are not declared as one shared owner.
Eraser activation is gated by pointer press state; hover erasure must not be reintroduced.
V37 has a material candidate gain. V26/Psico erase actions are not demonstrated as undo-restorable.
These are distinct semantics: V37 board-session tabs are not interchangeable with Psico sheet tabs.
V37 object handling is a candidate-specific gain, not a baseline requirement inferred for all PageKit surfaces.
Transient laser behavior exists across inspected surfaces.
V37 remains the registered best-known donor for laser/object transform behavior; do not promote its whole UX.
Responsive/full-viewport presentation and iframe allowFullscreen are not proof of the application Fullscreen API.
Catalog liveness is routing/discovery evidence only; it grants no Current/Human Accepted/Served authority.

regressions_and_risks.guard: Never rank V37 as globally superior to V26 from version number.
Laser/object or undo gains may be selectively donated without adopting the whole V37 UX.
Preserve pressed-only eraser semantics on every integration surface.
Do not collapse V37 typed undo back to simple pop when adopting erase/object operations.
Generic Pointer Events or UI copy mentioning Wacom does not prove pressure/button support.
Do not label responsive viewport behavior or iframe allowFullscreen as an application Fullscreen API implementation.
Keep V37 board-session tabs distinct from Psico whiteboard sheet tabs.
In V37 semantics, laser drag over an unselected object remains laser-only; selected object edit behavior is separately gated.
The Psicoanálisis PageKit page can donate consumer evidence but does not own Class Player lineage or shared whiteboard authority.
Do not invent missing intermediate version history from inaccessible historical chats.

integration_guidance.class_player_baseline: Use V26 as rollback/stability donor where the registered capability requires a known baseline.
selective_candidate_donors: V37 laser/object interaction and transform-tracking behavior
V37 multi-board/object model where a product owner explicitly wants those semantics
V37 typed undo when erase/object operations require reversible actions
integration_guidance.consumer_evidence: Use Psicoanálisis PageKit only to preserve consumer-specific global overlay, sheet, curve and annotation evidence.
integration_guidance.input_boundary: Any future shared interaction extraction must reconcile with the canonical interaction.touch-first/Focus Lease ownership rather than create a competing global adapter.
integration_guidance.promotion_boundary: No capability adoption changes Current, Human Accepted or Served state without the existing owner-specific validation and human gates.
